Digging can be a chosen vocation; bathing can mean rest, recognition, remembered care and company. The same commitment can make another use of a completed building intolerable, authorize a proposed seizure of transport, or press a client to accept a new site. The sustained question is how the department treats the answers of those whose labor, land, livelihood and leisure make its spring possible. Genuine attraction and harmful means coexist at particular endings. Neither a benevolent-service essence nor a pure destructive-joke essence can retain the complete range.
